How to create AI employees — start to finish, everything included The complete build of an AI employee, start to finish — the whole path in under four minutes. The agent underneath — every AI employee starts as an agent: a brain (the AI model), tools (real connections into your email, calendar, spreadsheets so it acts instead of only talking), and a loop (it works the job, checks itself, and keeps going until it's done). Feed the brain context and it works on YOUR business. The four upgrades that make it an employee — memory (corrections get written down and read back before every job — explain a thing once and it stays explained), permanent context (your world lives with it and changes as your business changes), skills (your way of doing a job, taught once, followed every time), and a schedule (an agent runs when you call it — an employee clocks in on its own, seven in the morning, inbox already sorted). The build tool — an AI coding assistant: Claude Code or Codex. That class of tool IS the agent machinery — it navigates your context, picks its next move, loops until the job is done, and carries memory between runs. You set it up in plain English, and when a piece you need exists nowhere, it writes that piece itself. The full assembly — pick one job, give it context, wire the tools, teach the skill, add memory, set the schedule. One rule built in: high-stakes moves wait for your yes; everything else runs around the clock. The ceiling — one employee becomes a pattern, patterns become a team, and the team becomes a department passing work to each other.
